verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a pip-installable Python framework with an official CLI (init, cloud deploy, eval) that a runtime probe ran non-interactively and keylessly via uvx. Its Evals framework runs described conversations against the real agent pipeline and reports pass/fail, and Pipecat Cloud exposes a REST API for managing agents and builds, so the automation building blocks are first-party. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless-mode documentation (e.g., CI pipeline integration, exit codes, non-interactive eval runs), and independent corroboration of use in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: the official Pipecat CLI (pypi pipecat-ai[cli]) ran keylessly via uvx
Pipecat runs it against your real agent (the same pipeline, the same services, the same code) and tells you whether the expectation still holds.
The private API (/v1...) manages agents, secrets, builds, regions, and organization settings.
